## Why

P34.21a landed the append-only attribution backfill (INSERT-only, queued for
its window) and the publish-time attribution gate. What remained was the
public layer: a re-export carrying the corrections, a dated correction note
the `/sources/` page renders from export bytes (E2-12: "earlier downloads
credited some rows to the wrong source"), the `sig-public` IAM leg that
stops serving the defective 09-27 tree, and the republish. The ticket
pauses both production legs on their own verbatim goes — this run engineers
them, tests them, and queues them; it does not execute them.

## What this does

- **Correction artifact (`exports/`).** `shaping_claims` projects
  `ld.decided_at, ld.basis` as trailing columns (NULL-safe; the
  pre-`rights_decision` fallback strips them to `NULL, NULL`), `ShapingClaim`
  parses them (absent on older/synthetic row sets), and
  `build_spine_export` emits `web/attribution_corrections.json`
  (`sig.attribution-corrections/1` — per-source `decided_at`, `basis`,
  `affected_rows`, source ids already alias-re-keyed) **only when a carried
  claim's effective decision basis carries the ADR-194 marker**. Absence is
  intentional and means no carried correction — the export never fabricates
  the note.
- **Dated note on `/sources/` (`web/`).** `getAttributionCorrections()`
  returns `null` in fixtures mode and when the artifact is absent, throws on
  a malformed artifact, and derives `corrected_on` (the latest decision
  date) from artifact data — never a hard-coded date. `sources.astro`
  renders the `data-copy="SL-20"` sentence only behind the artifact; the
  page stays static/zero-JS and licence rows still derive from export bytes.
- **L1 command (`ops/gcp/public-gate.sh`).** Dry-run by default and green in
  check mode without ADC; actions `prestate` (saved describe + IAM policy +
  read-only listing into an evidence dir), `list`, `prefixes` (excluded
  prefixes derived from `ops/cadence.toml` sig-public targets +
  `--fetch-targets` + `--exclude` + `tombstones/`, each `# reason=`
  recorded), `plan` (the exact IAM diff: the unconditional anonymous binding
  replaced by a `p34-21b-live-prefixes` conditioned `legacyObjectReader`
  keep, plus the tombstone text), `--apply` (refuses without
  `SIG_PUBLIC_GATE_GO`, the sha256-verified pre-state, `live:P34.3` on the
  saved describe, or inside 03:00–10:00Z), `--verify` (excluded → 200,
  non-excluded → 403/404, tombstone → 200). Rollback is `set-iam-policy`
  with the saved policy JSON, printed beside every plan. **No
  object-deletion path** — pinned by `tests/ops/test_public_gate_iac.py`.
- **Republish probe (`sig-ops republish-probe`,
  `ops/src/ops/republish_probe.py`).** Emits `sig.probe-run/1`: the cadence
  `http-absent` absence leg, a count-only handle crawl over repo/export/
  tiles/build trees plus a downloaded `sig-public` listing (matched handles
  are never printed), a ranged tile sample, and the attribution sample
  (every `attribution_required` row carries holder + `terms_url`).
  Unavailable legs report honest `skipped`; `overall` is pass/partial/fail;
  the record's `generated_at` must be ≤ 24 h for republish #2.
- **Copy + memory.** batch-02 gains `SL-20` (the `/sources/` note,
  `{correctedOn}` = injected data) and `TB-01` (the tombstone sentence) as
  `pending` sha256-pinned rows — the publish gate refuses `--apply` while a
  rendered sentence's row is unconfirmed (B-2). `ops/gcp/README.md` carries
  the L1/L2 runbooks (prerequisites, order, windows, rollback, no-delete
  invariants, rerun prompts). `D-P34.21b-1` + `D-P34.21b-2` are OPEN with
  owner/trigger/rerun prompts and e0 migration anchors.
